title: Oil Wars & Trump's Tweets Are Crashing Crypto Markets
description:
Oil prices are rising. Political tensions are escalating. And crypto markets are reacting.

In this video, we break down how oil, geopolitics, and even statements from figures like Trump can impact crypto prices — and why these moves are not random.

If you’ve been wondering why the market suddenly shifts, this is the missing piece most traders ignore.

And yes — there’s a promo code hidden in this video for a trade compensation bonus. Watch carefully so you don’t miss it.

⚠️ This video is for educational purposes only. Not financial advice. Markets are volatile — always do your own research.

asr.full_text: You think you're trading crypto, but right now you're trading war. And if you still look at Bitcoin like a normal, safe asset, you're probably missing the real driver. In this video, I'll show you what actually moves crypto now… from oil spikes and the Hormuz situation to decisions from Donald Trump that can shift the market in minutes. Because the market has changed changed crypto is no longer just an investment idea it became a real-world tool for payments pressure and speculation take the hormuz straight a key shipping route controlled by Iran where a big part of the world's oil passes because of the war and rising tensions, traffic there dropped sharply even after ceasefire talks. And here's where it gets serious. There have been reports that Iran may charge millions for passage and even consider payments in crypto in these high risk conditions. And all of this depends on political decisions, statements, deadlines, negotiations can escalate or calm the situation and instantly move global markets and in situations like this traditional systems slow down or break crypto is faster more flexible and sometimes it becomes the only way to move money this didn't start today countries under pressure have already used crypto for international payments so this system has been building for years now connected to your trades war to oil goes up oil to inflation pressure inflation to pressure on markets and that includes crypto and what actually moves the market day to day. Decisions, statements, deadlines. When global leaders change direction, markets react instantly. That's the environment you're trading in. And there's another layer. These events are not just happening. They're being traded. Some platforms now let people trade real-world events, from elections to cease fires. So crypto became three things at once, a payment system, a workaround under pressure and a trading layer for global events, all inside one market. So if you think you're just trading charts, you're not. You're trading a global system driven by real world events. And this is the key takeaway. If the market is driven by global events, you can't look at just one asset any more. Traders are already watching oil, stocks, gold. Not just crypto. so if you want to understand this market better, you need to do the same. On Margex, you can trade crypto and assets like gold in one place. Check the link in the pinned comment.
